description: This file defines the ModuleExtensionList class in Drupal, which manages and provides information about available modules, including their dependencies, profiles, and installation status.

classes.name: ModuleExtensionList
classes.description: A class that manages and provides a list of available Drupal modules, handling dependencies, profiles, and installation status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModuleExtensionList with necessary services and configuration.

methods.name: getExtensionDiscovery
methods.description: Retrieves the extension discovery object, setting profile directories if an active profile exists.

methods.name: getProfileDirectories
methods.description: Finds all installation profile paths based on the extension discovery.

methods.name: getActiveProfile
methods.description: Returns the active profile extension object, or null if none is active.

methods.name: doScanExtensions
methods.description: Scans and returns available extensions, modifying the list with active profile information.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Lists all modules, adding dependency and status information, and handling installation profile specifics.

methods.name: getInstalledExtensionNames
methods.description: Returns the list of installed extension names.

methods.name: ensureRequiredDependencies
methods.description: Recursively marks dependencies of required modules as required.
